name: YJ MGC Megaminx
description: The YJ MGC Magnetic Megaminx is a fresh addition to the popular, budget friendly MGC lineup! What makes this megaminx special is that it has many features found in top tier models for a more competitive price. "Ridges" were added to assist with grip and comfort which compliment to overall feel nicely. Vibrant shades were chosen with look-ahead in mind and contrast nicely.
